name: Card Printing
definition: A single physical or digital printing of a Magic: The Gathering card in one specific edition/set. It is the row grain of the cards table: the same card name printed in several sets yields several distinct card printings, each with its own uuid, setCode, rarity, artist and artwork metadata.
scope: Any analysis that filters, counts or lists cards; the workload's primary fact entity.

name: Card Name
definition: The canonical English name of a card, used in questions to identify a card (e.g. name = "Ancestor's Chosen"). Because the cards table is at printing grain, one name may match several rows across different sets.
scope: Card identification and filtering by name.

name: Card Set
definition: An edition, expansion or compilation set that groups card printings. Identified by a short code and described by a canonical English name, a block, a marketplace name and an online-availability code.
scope: Set-level membership, naming and attribute analysis.

name: Set Code
definition: Short alphanumeric identifier of a card set. It is the shared link key between card printings, set metadata and localized set names.
scope: Joining card printings to set metadata and set translations.

name: Set Name
definition: The canonical English name of a card set, as stored on the set record.
scope: Identifying a set by its printed English name.

name: Localized Set Name
definition: The name of a set translated into a specific language, stored per (setCode, language) pair. It is the only field that records a set's non-English name; the set record itself holds only the English name.
scope: Questions asking for a set's name in another language, or asking which languages a set is translated into.

name: Set Block
definition: The block or product grouping a set belongs to (for example Ice Age, Commander, Core Set). Many sets have no block value.
scope: Grouping and counting sets by product line or story block.

name: Set Marketplace Name
definition: The set name as used by the Magic card market (mcmName), which can differ from or be empty when the canonical set name is populated.
scope: Identifying a set by the name used on the card market.

name: Set Online Availability
definition: Whether a set is available on Magic: The Gathering Online, expressed by the presence of an MTGO code on the set record. A set without an MTGO code is not available there.
scope: Questions about whether a set appeared on MTGO.

name: Card Language
definition: The language of a foreign-language card record. Only non-English languages appear; English card data lives on the cards table itself and is not represented as a language value.
scope: Selecting or counting foreign-language versions of cards.

name: Foreign Card Name
definition: The translated name of a card in a given foreign language.
scope: Identifying a card by its localized printed name.

name: Foreign Card Text
definition: The translated rules (box) text of a card in a given foreign language, including reminder text. This is what a question means by the "text" of a card in a language.
scope: Retrieving the printed rules text of a card in a non-English language.

name: Foreign Flavor Text
definition: The translated flavor text of a card in a given foreign language, stored separately from the rules text.
scope: Retrieving flavor text in a non-English language.

name: Format Legality
definition: A record stating the legality status of one card printing in one named play format. One card printing has many legality records, one per format it has been evaluated for.
scope: Questions about whether a card is legal, banned or restricted in a format.

name: Play Format
definition: A named constructed or limited play format in which legalities are evaluated, such as commander, gladiator, legacy, modern, pauper, pioneer, standard, vintage.
scope: Grouping and filtering legalities by format.

name: Legality Status
definition: The legality verdict of a card printing in a play format. Values are Legal, Banned and Restricted; the stored labels are capitalized and are not identical to the lowercase wording often used in natural-language questions.
scope: Filtering legalities by verdict.

name: Card Ruling
definition: An official clarification issued for a card, with a publication date and ruling text. Rulings attach to a card identity rather than to a specific set printing.
scope: Retrieving official rulings for cards.

name: Card Artist
definition: The illustrator credited on a card printing. Names are stored exactly as credited, which may differ from the spelling used in natural-language questions.
scope: Filtering cards by illustrator.

name: Card Rarity
definition: The rarity of a card printing: common, uncommon, rare or mythic.
scope: Filtering or grouping cards by rarity.

name: Card Border Color
definition: The border treatment of a card printing, which distinguishes the classic border generations as well as modern borderless and special borders.
scope: Filtering cards by border type.

name: Card Power
definition: The power value of a creature card printing, stored as text. Non-creature cards have no power, and some creatures have a variable power, so the absence of power is represented in more than one way.
scope: Filtering or comparing cards by power.

name: Mana Cost
definition: The symbolic mana cost string printed on a card, combining colored and generic mana symbols.
scope: Understanding the cost of a card before numeric conversion.

name: Converted Mana Cost
definition: The total mana value of a card expressed as a single number, obtained from the card's mana cost. A larger value means the card costs more converted mana.
scope: Comparing or thresholding cards by total mana value.

name: Card Original Type
definition: The type line as originally printed on the card, which uses older wording conventions that differ from the modern type line (for example summon-based creature types).
scope: Filtering cards by their originally printed type line.

name: Card Subtypes
definition: The creature and other subtypes of a card printing, stored as a comma-separated list in a single field.
scope: Filtering cards by subtype.

name: Content Warning Flag
definition: A flag marking a card printing whose properties or values are missing or degraded in the source data. It records a data-completeness problem, not a gameplay or content-advisory property.
scope: Identifying cards with missing or degraded data.

name: Story Spotlight Flag
definition: A flag marking card printings that are part of a set's story spotlight sequence.
scope: Selecting story spotlight cards.

name: EDHRec Rank
definition: A popularity rank of a card on EDHRec. A smaller value means a more highly ranked card, so rank 1 is the top-ranked card; cards without a rank have no value.
scope: Popularity-based selection and ordering of cards.

name: Share Percentage
definition: The proportion of a filtered subset of cards within a stated reference population, expressed as a percentage. It requires two counts drawn from the same reference population: the qualifying subset and the population itself.
scope: Percentage and share questions over cards.
